    Representatives of presilting objects on prescribed projective terms #

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_representative_on_terms (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) (A B : FGModuleCat R) [Module.Projective R ↑A] [Module.Projective R ↑B] (h : P.projectiveClass = ProjectiveClass.of ⟨B, ⋯⟩ - ProjectiveClass.of ⟨A, ⋯⟩) :
    ∃ (d : A ⟶ B), (ofDifferential d).IsPresilting ∧ Nonempty (P.homotopyObject ≅ (ofDifferential d).homotopyObject)

    The rigid-terms lemma: the source and target may be prescribed independently whenever the difference of their classes is the class of P.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_rational_pencil_automorphisms (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) (σ : P.source ⟶ P.target) :
    let F := RatFunc k; have G := FieldExtension.extend k F R; ∃ (a : G.obj P.source ≅ G.obj P.source) (b : G.obj P.target ≅ G.obj P.target), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a.hom (G.map P.differential) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (G.map P.differential + (algebraMap (Polynomial k) F) Polynomial.X • G.map (σ - P.differential)) b.hom

    Along the line from a presilting differential to any other differential on the same projectives, the generic fiber is isomorphic to the rigid one on the scalar-extended modules over the rational function field.
